questions.question: If I ____ earlier, I would have caught the bus.
questions.explanation: Third Conditional: If + had + V3 → had left.

questions.question: If she had known the truth, she ____ upset.
questions.explanation: Kết quả trong quá khứ → would have been.

questions.question: If they ____ harder, they would have passed the exam.
If he had brought his map, he ____ lost.
questions.explanation: Kết quả không xảy ra trong quá khứ → wouldn’t have gotten.

questions.question: If we ____ more time, we would have visited more places.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc đặc biệt: had had (Past Perfect).

questions.question: If she had called me, I ____ her.
questions.explanation: Would have + V3 cho kết quả quá khứ → would have helped.

questions.question: If you had listened to me, you ____ the mistake.
questions.explanation: Diễn tả hậu quả đã không xảy ra → wouldn’t have made.

questions.question: If they ____ earlier, they wouldn’t have missed the meeting.
If he ____ the instructions, he would have fixed it.
questions.explanation: Điều kiện quá khứ → had followed.

questions.question: If we had seen the sign, we ____ the wrong way.
questions.explanation: Kết quả giả định trong quá khứ → wouldn’t have gone.

questions.question: If she ____ her umbrella, she wouldn’t have gotten wet.
If I had known you were there, I ____ hello.
questions.explanation: Would have + V3 → would have said.

questions.question: If they had prepared better, they ____ the competition.
questions.explanation: Kết quả giả định quá khứ → would have won.

questions.question: If he ____ the truth, he wouldn’t have trusted them.
If we had left earlier, we ____ the traffic jam.
questions.explanation: Hậu quả quá khứ không xảy ra → would have avoided.
